content_data.meeting_title: Q4 Student Recruitment Campaign Planning & Performance Review
agenda_items: Review performance metrics from autumn enrollment campaign across European markets
Discuss budget reallocation for digital channels in upcoming recruitment cycle
Finalize content calendar for social media campaigns targeting prospective students
key_decisions: Adopt new CRM system to improve lead nurturing and student journey tracking across all European markets
Increase investment in Instagram and TikTok advertising by 35% for next recruitment period based on strong conversion rates
Postpone rebranding initiative for continuing education division until completion of market research in 3 months
Launch pilot programme with student ambassadors in Germany, Netherlands, and Poland starting in 6 weeks
